newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sidel expects 30 pct jump in 97 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Sidel expects 30 pct jump in 97 net profit.

text.p: French packaging firm Sidel expects a 30 percent jump in 1997 net profits and a 20 percent rise in turnover, company chairman Francis Olivier told a news conference on Tuesday.

"For 1997, we expect a net margin along the lines of the second half of 1996 (of 9.1 percent). We are counting on turnover growth of 20 percent, in line with the increase in the order book (of 23.7 percent) and we expect profits to be up 30 percent," he said.
The group announced a fall in 1996 net profit to 263 million francs from 374.1 million in 1995, on turnover that totalled 3.12 billion francs compared with 3.70 billion the previous year.
